summary: The exact candidate correctly removes an unconditional, stale self.fused_experts read and fixes original report bug 3 at the Python dispatch boundary. It is a partial fix only and does not resolve or verify the other eight reported deployment failures.

tests.what_was_measured: At the recorded base, GGUFMoEMethod lacked fused_experts, apply raised AttributeError, and the mocked fused_moe_gguf kernel was not called.
At the exact candidate commit, both submitted regression tests passed (2 passed, 1 deselected), covering standard argument forwarding/result propagation and rejection of unsupported activation.

Standard dispatch reached the mocked GGUF kernel and propagated output; an extraneous fused_experts instance attribute no longer affected direct dispatch; bypass-shaped top-k input still failed before kernel invocation.
Both changed Python files compiled successfully.
Candidate diff contains trailing whitespace only in reports/j-b969a0ab5e43/raw/pytest_after.txt; no source whitespace error was reported.

remaining_counterexamples: Bugs 1, 2, and 4 through 9 from the original nine-bug report are unchanged and unverified by this candidate.
A bypassed/non-standard top-k representation still fails in GGUFMoEMethod.apply because it is unpacked as StandardTopKOutput.
The submitted kernel test uses a mock and does not establish GGUF numerical correctness, weight materialization correctness, TP=2 collectives, or multi-node serving.
remaining_limitations: The available GPU is AMD gfx950/ROCm, while the relevant GGUF path is unsupported on HIP in this checkout.
The reported GX10 CUDA hardware, Qwen3-235B-A22B GGUF weights, second node, and TP=2 topology were unavailable.
No full-model inference, transport/serving validation, CUDA graph capture, or distributed workload was run.
No native source changed, so there was no native component to rebuild.
